title: Guides: AI for business units | halilneed
desc: Four short interactive guides for business units: a first step into AI, a first AI model, which model for which process, personal data. Each one is an interactive page and a PDF, in English and Turkish.
lead: Four short guides for business units that want to put AI into their own processes. Each one is an interactive page that goes step by step, and a PDF; in English and in Turkish. The first step is fully open. Try the first two steps of the other three here; the full guides are free PDFs on Gumroad.
guidesLead: Each guide has four steps. The first two are open here: you pick, change or add something and see the result straight away. Steps 3 and 4 and the full PDF are free on Gumroad.
requestP: Hear by email when a new guide is out. At most one message a month, and you can unsubscribe at any time.
requestSmall: If your team has a specific question or a process where it gets stuck, write to halil@halilneed.agency.
